segments.text:
V. 13.
Thy prayer is heard—Let us obſerve with Pleaſure, that the Prayers of pious Worſhippers come up with Acceptance before GOD; to whom no coſtly Perfume is ſo ſweet, as the Fragrancy of an upright Heart. An Anſwer of Peace was here returned, when the Caſe ſeemed to be moſt helpleſs. Let us wait patiently for the LORD, and leave to his own Wiſdom the Time and Manner wherein He will appear for us. Thou ſhalt call his name John—John ſignifies the Grace or Favour of Jehovah. A Name well ſuiting the Perſon, who was afterwards ſo hightly in Favour with GOD, and endued with Abundance of Grace; and who opened a Way to the moſt glorious Diſpenſation of Grace in the Meſſiah's Kingdom. And ſo Zacharias' former Prayers for a Child, and the Prayer which he, as the Repreſentative of the People, was probably offering at this very Time, for the Appearing of the Meſſiah, were remarkably anſwered in the Birth of his Fore-runner.
